actualSubmittedPrompt.text: Use the supplied image as the exact first frame. One uninterrupted 8-second landscape shot with a locked eye-height camera in the same framing. At screen-right the single sandworm maw closes over the burning wheeled rig: the rig tilts and disappears beneath it, sand spills from the worm's lip, and a wave of dust rolls toward the camera then thins. End with the rig gone, the maw closing and dust settling. No second worm, no lunge toward the man and no additional teeth animation beyond the closing. The man stays unchanged at screen-left: right palm raised and open, five fingers, eyes toward the camera, mouth closed, one blink at most; no step, head turn or gesture. Preserve his face geometry, curls, blue eyes, small AL between the brows, vertical G-A-I-B on the chin, paired segmented neck worms and throat eye-disc. Keep the single breather tube on the same cheek, the existing jewelry on the same side, and the bronze armor and tan hood exactly as supplied. Do not repair, mirror, duplicate or add features. Preserve the warm overcast haze as the key light. Only the existing fire flickers on the rig, worm lip and dust, with a faint local reflection on his far cheek; it gutters as the rig disappears. No new light, whole-frame wash or color shift. No camera movement, cuts, new characters, objects, text or watermarks. Silent output: no speech, singing, music, narration or sound effects.
